title_zh: 基于长程信用分配的 Harness 稳定进化方法
title_en: Stable Harness Evolution via Long-Horizon Credit Assignment

scope.study_focus: long-horizon value of harness modifications; multi-round effect first
scope.evolution_target: ModularRSI basic modular Terminus2 five modules, denoted H0

solver.note: Reuse the already-working DeepSeek Flash solver from meta-harness-repro.

evolver.output: modification plan only; may touch multiple modules
evolver.note: Before a trainable evolver exists, use the same model family with a frozen prompt/budget. Training updates only the evolver.

editor.note: Plans are applied by a fixed editor. Replay re-applies the saved patch; replay does not re-ask a model to edit.

harness.license_note: ModularRSI original contributions are CC BY-NC 4.0. Do not vendor upstream source into this private repo.

baseline_control.role: read-only control; not modified in this project

proposal.use: execution evidence for the evolver; evolver may see these

reward.use: immediate and long-horizon rewards; evolver must not see these at decision time

task_sets.isolation_rule: proposal evidence and reward scores are never mixed into one unlabeled pool

evaluation.unit: external task tests via Harbor; agent-internal verification is not the final score
evaluation.cross_batch_check: required by this protocol even if upstream ModularRSI still lists it as future work

noise_probe.purpose: estimate score flip rate under H0

retry.retry_when: official reward missing AND failure looks infrastructural: missing result.json, HTTP 429/502/503/504, connection, docker, auth
retry.do_not_retry: reward present including 0; agent timeout; limits exceeded; apply-failure

metrics.process_regression: sum over path steps of max(0, best_ancestor_mean - current_mean) on the reward set
metrics.long_horizon_reward: mean over Monte Carlo branches of terminal_gain, minus process_regression aggregated per protocol note in docs/experiment_protocol.md
metrics.recovery: after a process_regression event, fraction of branches that later reach or exceed the pre-drop ancestor mean
metrics.noise_rule: a single-task flip that already flipped under H0 noise probe is not credited as modification effect

budgets_and_stops.week1_scope: protocol + H0 smoke + noise/cost on few light tasks; one replayable modification only after H0 is stable
budgets_and_stops.do_not_train_until: long-horizon reward analysis report shows usable signal above score noise
budgets_and_stops.policy_versioning: every execution and modification record stores protocol_id and evolver_policy_id; do not merge pools across policies
